Message.Name: Order Amend Message
Message.Description: Generated when an order amendment updates the volume downward or the position in the order book.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect amended this order in the order book.

Field.Name: T1
Field.Description: The time of the order amend from the LMEselect gateway. Null for stop loss and speedbump orders.

Field.Name: T2
Field.Description: The time when LMEselect captured the order amend request. Null for stop loss and speedbump orders.

Field.Name: T3
Field.Description: The time when LMEselect published this order amend request. Null for stop loss and speedbump orders. The specification types this field Unit64, a typo for Uint64; the stated length of eight bytes agrees.

Field.Name: TradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Tradable Instrument ID.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID of the amended order.

Field.Name: BuySell
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Absolute outstanding volume.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of order, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: OrderBookPosition
Field.Description: Relative order position within the order book, price and side.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Filler.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: Generated when an order is cancelled from the order book.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect cancelled this order from the order book.

Field.Name: T1
Field.Description: The time of the order request from the LMEselect gateway. Null for mass cancellations and trade halt.

Field.Name: T2
Field.Description: The time when LMEselect captured the order request. Null for mass cancellations and trade halt.

Field.Name: T3
Field.Description: The time when LMEselect cancelled this order. The specification types this field Unit64, a typo for Uint64; the stated length of eight bytes agrees.

Field.Name: TradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Tradable Instrument ID.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID for the cancelled order.

Field.Name: BuySell
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Filler.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Generated when an order is executed. Not published for an aggressing order unless it matches with a resting implied order; publishing for a resting implied order occurs only when two implied orders are matched. If an electronic cross order is matched against itself off book, the message is published with a SubTypeOfTrade of nine.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect created the trade that executed this order.

Field.Name: TradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Tradable Instrument ID of the trade.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the trade, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Trade volume.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID assigned by LMEselect. Null if the order has not previously been published.

Field.Name: MatchID
Field.Description: An id that can be used to identify all orders that matched against each other.

Field.Name: TradeCancelFlag
Field.Description: Trade Cancel Flag.

Field.Name: SubTypeOfTrade
Field.Description: Sub type of trade. The specification types this field UiInt8, a typo for Uint8; the stated length of one byte agrees.

Field.Name: TradeBuySell
Field.Description: The side of the trade for this order.

Field.Name: StrategyLegCount
Field.Description: Number of legs present.

Field.Name: Executed Legs
Field.Description: One entry per leg of the executed strategy.
